overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation on the hushed-conversation, pre-meeting, and minutes-publication allegations, declined the voting-bloc claim as unspecific, and noted untimely minutes, which it addresses in OML 2019-53.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a Board member and Board counsel held a hushed conversation during the July 12, 2018 meeting, which he said was improper deliberation.
allegations.key_passage: First, because the Open Meeting Law only applies to members of a public body, any communication that may have occurred on July 12 between Board counsel, who is not a member of the Board, and a single Board member does not constitute deliberation.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a quorum of Board members forms a 'voting bloc' that shows they deliberate outside noticed meetings, without identifying any meeting or topic.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review this allegation as it does not identify a particular meeting date or topic about which this group of individuals allegedly deliberated outside of a noticed meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a quorum of Board members deliberated in an inaudible manner immediately before the July 19, 2018 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Second, we find no evidence that the Board discussed Board business prior to the July 19 meeting, but rather exchanged personal pleasantries while waiting for the meeting to begin,

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to publish certain 2018 meeting minutes.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find no violation for the Board’s failure to publish its meeting minutes.

allegations.summary: Noted in passing: the Board had not created and approved minutes for meetings held since February 2018 when it responded in September 2018, which the Board acknowledged.
allegations.key_passage: However, we note that, because draft minutes of meetings held since February 2018 had not yet been created at the time the Board responded to this complaint on September 7, 2018, the Board has failed to timely create and approve its meeting minutes; an issue the Board acknowledged in its response.
